title: The Hungry Cellar
author: Ada Whitlock
blurb: Ada Quintana, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
